ingress: Your website should last years — not drain your budget every month.
paragraphs: Are you an artist who wants a dedicated website, but finds the options too costly over time or too rigid for your needs?
Most website builders lock you into monthly or yearly subscriptions. Over five years, those fees can easily add up to €1,000 — a real drain on a working artist's business.
That's why I created ArtistPages: a personal website service built specifically for artists.

For one fixed price, I will listen to your needs and build a custom website tailored to your profile. This gives you a strong first impression you can update yourself, without the recurring fees (except for the custom domain being ~€5–10 per year).
